text: For tomorrow's Northwind import: if their CSV has no owner_email column, who gets the accounts?
The importing user. That's the existing mapOwner behavior.
And if the column exists but one email is mistyped?
That row must fail. We should not silently assign the importer when an explicit owner is invalid. I'll make the error identifier visible in the runbook.
Please include the exact code in the support note. Customers paste those into tickets.
Will do. Current code is CC_IMPORT_017 for unknown owner email.
